summary: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, disclosing its Q2 2026 earnings (Item 2.02) and an update on its planned divestiture of its Food Ingredients business to CVC Capital Partners (Item 8.01). The Purchase Agreement, signed May 29, 2026, covers substantially all assets of the Food Ingredients disposal group, with IFF retaining an approximately 10% minority equity interest. The transaction is expected to close by end of Q2 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other conditions. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for regulatory milestones and closing conditions.
